energySource: Merck Veterinary Manual, nutritional requirements of small animals
units: Weights are KILOGRAMS. Heights, where present, are CENTIMETRES.

lifeStages.name: Neutered adult
lifeStages.note: The commonest case for a pet dog.

lifeStages.name: Obesity-prone
lifeStages.note: Less active, or a breed that gains easily.

lifeStages.name: Weight loss
lifeStages.note: Applied to the RER of the TARGET weight, not the current one.

lifeStages.name: Puppy under 4 months
lifeStages.note: The highest metabolic rate of any life stage.

lifeStages.name: Puppy 4-12 months
lifeStages.note: Growth slowing but still well above adult.
